name: WeAct STM32G474 Core Board
description: Compact STM32G474CEU6 board (170 MHz Cortex-M4F, 512 KB flash, 128 KB RAM) with USB-C and two 2x12 headers for about $6; analog/motor-control/HRTIM chip very cheaply.
notes: Two double-row (2x12) headers along the long sides plus a 4-pin SWD header; NRST, BOOT0 and a user button. No ST-LINK on board: use an external SWD probe or the ROM USB DFU (BOOT0).
USB, CAN-FD, 5 ADCs, 4 DACs, op-amps and the HRTIM are all available on the headers; there is no CAN transceiver. PA11/PA12 are shared between USB and CAN.
GPIO count is 37 broken-out GPIOs (UFQFPN48 has 38). Cheaper STM32G431CBU6 and a 'Long' G474CBT6 variant exist: check the exact listing.
No header data: double-row layout not verified.
